1525318.steps: 1. On the Dynamic DNS GUI page, Deselect the Enabled checkbox for one of the profiles created in previous test cases. 2. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page. Verify the Enabled checkbox is unchecked on the page. 3. Verify that status for the chosen profile now contains the word Disabled 4. Verify that a log entry has been filed: DDNS association [your domain name] disabled. 5. Enter configuration mode for the profile. 6. Verify that the Enabled checkbox is unchecked on the configuration page. 7. On the advanced tab, select the Specify IP Address manually radio button and enter the specified IP address (the specified IP should be different with the actual wan IP.). Press OK. 8. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page. 9. Verify that status for the chosen profile has not changed, in particular that the IP address has not changed. 10. On the Dynamic DNS GUI page, Select the Enabled checkbox for the chosen profile. 11. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page.Verify the Enabled checkbox is now checked on the page. 12. Verify that status for the chosen has now changed to the specified IP Address and that the word Disabled is NOT present. 13. Verify that 2 log entries have been filed: DDNS association [your domain name] enabled and DDNS Update success for domain '*.*'. Online IP updated. 14. Enter configuration mode for the profile and deselect the Enabled checkbox.click ok. 15. After the configuration is updated,Verify the Enabled checkbox is unchecked on the main ddns profile page. 16. Verify that status for the chosen profile now contains the word Disabled 17. Verify that a log entry has been filed: DDNS association [your domain name] disabled. 18. Enter configuration mode for the profile and verify the enabled checkbox is unchecked on the configuration page. 19. On the advanced tab, select the Let the DDNS provider detect the IP Address radio button (the wan ip address should be different with the one specified above). Press OK. 20. After the configuration is updated,refresh the GUI DDNS page. 21. Verify that status for the chosen profile has not been changed, in particular that the IP address has not been changed. 22. Enter configuration mode for the profile and select the Enabled checkbox.click ok. 23. After the configuration is updated,Verify the Enabled checkbox is now checked on the main ddns profile page. 24. Verify that status for the chosen has now changed to the WAN IP Address and that the word Disabled is NOT present. 25. Verify that 2 log entries have been filed: DDNS association [your domain name] enabled and DDNS Update success for domain '*.*'. Online IP updated. 26. Go to the configuration page of the profile,verify the enable checkbox is now checked.then close the pop-up window. 27. On the Dynamic DNS GUI page, Deselect the Online checkbox for this profile. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page. 28. The status will then indicate: Taken offline 29. On the Dynamic DNS GUI page, Deselect the Enable checkbox for this profile. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page. 30. Verify that status for the chosen profile contains the message: Taken offline locally Disabled as of todays date. 31. Enter configuration mode of this profile. 32. Verify that BOTH the Enabled and Online checkboxes are unchecked on the configuration page. 33. On the advanced tab, select the Specify IP Address manually radio button and enter the specified IP address. Press OK. 34. After the configuration has updated, on the GUI DNS page, Select the Online checkbox of the profile. 35. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page. 36. Verify Status field contains: On-line: ip address Disabled as of today's date or similar. 37. On the GUI DNS page, Select the Enable checkbox. 38. Wait 10 to 15 seconds, then refresh the GUI DDNS page. 39. Verify that the status for the chosen profile now shows the association Online at the Specified IP address. 40. Repeat steps 1 thru 39 for the remaining 3 providers.

1525320.steps: 1. Create a new profile for dyndns.org(input the correct informations and leave all checkboxes default settings),make sure everything is ok for the new profile.(status,log,etc) 2. On the web browser, go to the DynDNS.org website and login to the test account. 3. Navigate to the settings page and note the IP Address associated with the domain name of the new profile. 4. On the UUT GUI, select the Network->Settings (or Interfaces) page. 5. Verify that the WAN IP Address is the same as the IP Address noted in step 3. 6. Open the Dynamic DNS GUI page and select the configure icon for this association. 7. Open the Advanced tab. Verify that the Online Settings box Let the server detect the IP Address is checked. These steps have then verified the correct operation of this setting. 8. Now, select the Online Settings box Specify IP Address manually and enter the specified IP address available to you in the text box.click OK. 9. After the update completes, refresh the web browser page for dyndns.org. 10. Verify that the IP Addrress is now the specified IP address just entered in the text box. 11. Refresh the DDNS GUI page. Verify that the status now reads On-line: [the new address] as of [todays date/time]. 12. This has verified the operation of the Specify IP Address manually check box. 13. Select the configure icon to edit this association once more. Open the Advanced tab. 14. Select the Let the DDNS provider detect the IP Address box. Press OK. 15. After the update completes, refresh the web browser page for this association. 16. Verify that the IP Addrress is now the sonicwall box's WAN IP or another public IP(in case the box is behind another firewall and the WAN IP is a private address). 17. Refresh the DDNS GUI page. 18. Verify that the status now reads On-line: [the WAN IP address] as of [todays date/time]. 19. This has verified the operation of Let the DDNS provider detect the IP Address WAN IP check box. 20. Repeate step 1 to 19 for the remaining 3 service providers.
